learning_objectives.vi: Theo dõi mũi tên trong sơ đồ giáo dục và điền đúng lứa tuổi, môn học hoặc lựa chọn sau 16 tuổi.

content.vi: Trước khi bật audio, xác định mỗi ô trống cần số tuổi, môn học hay lựa chọn học tập. Theo dõi các từ chỉ chuyển hướng như another route và after.
content.en: Before playing audio, identify whether each gap needs an age, subject or pathway. Follow signposts such as another route and after.

vocabulary.meaning_vi: lớp đầu của bậc tiểu học

strategies.vi: Làm bài trước khi xem đáp án; ghi lại câu chưa chắc và giải thích vì sao đáp án đúng.
strategies.en: Attempt the task first, then explain why the supported answer is right.

passages.title: L-B
passages.text: In England, Reception is part of the early years stage and is usually for children aged four to five. Key stage 2 covers ages seven to eleven; science and foreign languages are compulsory subjects. At sixteen, after GCSEs, students may continue in school sixth form or college, begin vocational training, or combine employment with part-time study.

audios.title: Education pathways: guided chart
audios.transcript:
Tutor: Look at the simplified education pathway on your worksheet. Reception, in the early years stage, is usually for children aged four to five. Key stage two comes later, for children aged seven to eleven. Alongside foreign languages, science is a compulsory subject at key stage two in England.
Student: What happens at sixteen?
Tutor: After key stage four and the General Certificate of Secondary Education, or G C S E, students have several routes. They may continue in a school sixth form or a college. A vocational qualification can lead to employment. Another route is to start work and combine it with part-time study.
Student: How should I complete the chart?
Tutor: Follow the arrows carefully and decide what kind of information each gap requires before listening again.
